hero.source_note: Book-specific cartoon dinosaur in underpants — source from Creative Fabrica or TPT clip art matching Claire Freedman illustration style

ambiguous.issue: Could map to a physical fight image or a conflict/argument symbol

ambiguous.issue: Could mean the pattern (polka dots / spots) or the verb 'to spot / see'

notes: Several key vocab items (dinosaur, underpants, t-rex, stegosaurus, triceratops, brontosaurus, striped underpants, polka dot underpants, cave, clothesline, laugh, roar, big, small) already exist in activity_images or aac_extras — reuse these assets. 'Spotted' is chosen over 'polka dot' as a more transferable descriptive word, but 'polka dot underpants' from existing assets could substitute. 'Caveman' is a central character type driving the plot (cavemen invented underpants). 'Fight' captures the core conflict of dinosaurs battling over underpants. The hero slot should use a book-cover-style T-Rex-in-underpants image to maximise recognition.
